title: 密鑰生命週期管理
summary: 以密鑰狀態、期限與受控更換串連 16 個領域技術單元、32 個保存步驟；分析架構、原理、介面、故障、量化案例與防禦證據。
summaryEn: Sixteen domain-specific technical units and 32 saved steps connect key states, lifetimes and controlled rotation through architecture, principles, interfaces, faults, quantitative cases and defensive evidence.
scope: 公開原理的離線／本地合成資料工程教育。只使用自行生成資料或明確獲授權的測試環境；不提供真實目標掃描、漏洞利用、惡意程式、車輛／工控注入或實際射頻發射程序。數值為原創假設，非供應商保證或現場驗收標準。
scopeEn: Offline/local synthetic-data engineering education from public principles. Use authored data or explicitly authorized test environments only. No real-target scanning, exploitation, malware, vehicle/OT injection or live RF procedures. Numerical cases are original assumptions, not supplier guarantees or field acceptance criteria.

stages.title: 需求、元件與基本模型
stages.description: 四個領域技術單元各完成原理建模與對照證據，共八項可個別保存的作業。
stages.descriptionEn: Four domain units each pair principle modeling with controlled evidence, producing eight separately saved tasks.

steps.title: 資產關聯：架構與原理
steps.titleEn: Asset associations: architecture and principle
steps.objective: 針對「資產關聯」建立有邊界、可反駁的系統模型。
steps.objectiveEn: For asset associations, construct a bounded falsifiable system model.
steps.instruction: 觀看師傅的功能示意後，以「資產關聯」為中心標出輸入、輸出、信任或資源邊界，並在學徒工作台排列資料流或元件。原理是：每把鍵應有關聯資料、用途與責任人。 使用自行編寫的兩組小型資料或試算表，建立基準與一次只改一項的對照：固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 先寫出可被反駁的預測；把「狀態機」視為相鄰問題，說明它如何影響模型而不能混同。數值只採本課假想算例或自訂並列明單位；本步保存架構圖、假設表與預測。
steps.instructionEn: After the mentor functional diagram, mark inputs, outputs and trust/resource boundaries around asset associations, then arrange components or data flows in the apprentice workspace. Principle: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner. Create two small authored datasets or spreadsheet cases: a baseline and a one-variable change. Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Predict a falsifiable outcome before evaluating it. Treat key state machine as a neighboring issue and explain its influence without conflating them. Use only the stated hypothetical case or declared assumed inputs/units. Save the architecture, assumptions and prediction.
steps.observation: 固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 比較「資產關聯」與「狀態機」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Compare whether evidence for asset associations and key state machine supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 輪替鍵必須刪除所有舊資料才能成功。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Key rotation requires deleting all old data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資產關聯」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for asset associations. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.

knowledge.title: 原理、架構與適用邊界
knowledge.text: 每把鍵應有關聯資料、用途與責任人。
knowledge.textEn: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner.

knowledge.title: 相鄰機制與不可混同處
knowledge.text: 相鄰的「狀態機」：預啟用、啟用與停用的操作資格不同。 必須另列其證據，不能把這項機制的通過當作「資產關聯」已通過。
knowledge.textEn: Neighboring key state machine: Preactive, active and deactivated keys have different operation permissions. Record its evidence separately; its success does not prove asset associations passes.

knowledge.title: 受控對照與證據品質
knowledge.text: 固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 只變一個條件，保留相同資料格式、時間範圍及分母；模型估計與實測證據要分別標記。
knowledge.textEn: Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Change one condition and retain comparable formats, intervals and denominators; label estimates separately from measured evidence.

knowledge.title: 可重算的原創假想例
knowledge.text: 假想每月新建 100 把資料鍵、每鍵 256 bit，原始鍵材每月 3200 byte；索引、包裝與審計通常更多，不能用 3.2 kB 推算完整 KMS 儲存。
knowledge.textEn: Creating 100 assumed 256-bit data keys monthly produces 3200 bytes of raw key material; metadata, wrapping and audits add storage, so 3.2 kB is not total KMS storage.

quiz.question: 針對「資產關聯」的原理與可觀測性，哪項最直接成立？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement most directly explains the principle/observability of asset associations?
options: 每把鍵應有關聯資料、用途與責任人。
輪替鍵必須刪除所有舊資料才能成功。
只檢查「狀態機」，便可取代「資產關聯」的專屬驗證。
optionsEn: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner.
Key rotation requires deleting all old data.
Checking key state machine alone replaces verification specific to asset associations.
quiz.explanation: 每把鍵應有關聯資料、用途與責任人。 相鄰的「狀態機」有不同責任：預啟用、啟用與停用的操作資格不同。因此不能用該項通過或課內誤判取代本單元證據。
quiz.explanationEn: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner. Neighboring key state machine has a different role: Preactive, active and deactivated keys have different operation permissions. Its success or the stated misconception cannot replace unit-specific evidence.

steps.title: 資產關聯：對照試驗與證據
steps.titleEn: Asset associations: controlled experiment and evidence
steps.objective: 針對「資產關聯」完成含競爭原因及不確定度的驗收紀錄。
steps.objectiveEn: For asset associations, complete acceptance evidence with competing causes and uncertainty.
steps.instruction: 重播本單元示意，讀取自製的基準與擾動紀錄，不接觸未授權目標。對照「每把鍵應有關聯資料、用途與責任人。」，執行下列紙上或本地合成資料試驗：固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 分開記錄預測、觀察與不確定度，再提出至少兩個可能原因；利用「狀態機」的獨立證據排除一個原因。若結果只來自模型，標記為模擬，不能當作真實設備量測。最後說明目前應接受、保留或拒絕哪一項要求，並保存可重算資料。
steps.instructionEn: Replay the unit diagram and inspect your authored baseline/perturbed records without accessing unauthorized targets. Evaluate the principle: Each key needs associated data, purpose and owner. Conduct this paper or local synthetic-data experiment: Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Record prediction, observation and uncertainty separately, propose two competing causes and use independent evidence from key state machine to exclude one. Model outputs must remain labeled simulation, not physical measurements. Explain which requirement to accept, hold or reject and retain recomputable records.
steps.observation: 固定資料，只改鑰的 active/retired 狀態。 比較「資產關聯」與「狀態機」的證據是否支持相同推論。
steps.observationEn: Fix data and vary active/retired key states. Compare whether evidence for asset associations and key state machine supports the same inference.
steps.failure: 輪替鍵必須刪除所有舊資料才能成功。 這是本課要排除的誤判；先核對模型邊界、來源版本及缺失證據。
steps.failureEn: Key rotation requires deleting all old data. This is a misconception to reject; check boundaries, source versions and missing evidence.
steps.check: 提交「資產關聯」的功能草圖、基準／擾動表、單位或欄位定義、可反駁預測及接受／保留理由。需能重算本課假想例，並說明相鄰機制不可取代的驗證。
steps.checkEn: Submit a functional sketch, baseline/perturbation table, unit/field definitions, falsifiable prediction and accept/hold rationale for asset associations. Recompute the course case and explain verification that the neighboring mechanism cannot replace.
